name: Emudori
source:
Emudori is Lavinia's bird, her personal assistant and loyal subordinate.
Emudori is extremely pompous and over-educated, and always supports the queen. However, Emudori often makes wisecracks, getting beaten by Lavinia and Alice as a result.
Being a resident of Sweet Wonderland, Emudori also participates in the game.

[Edited from [url=http://blog.pucp.edu.pe/item/15731/eroge-review-alice-parade-parte-i]Iori's review[/url]]
